summary:
We are young dreamers from Sri Lanka with one ultimate goal: to one day walk the halls of NASA and serve humanity through space exploration. Growing up without wealth or high-end resources, many told us that space science was out of our reach. We refused to accept that. Competing in the NASA International Space Apps Challenge is our chance to prove that raw talent, relentless curiosity, and a burning passion for the cosmos are stronger than money. Every line of code in this project carries our sweat, late nights, and unbreakable hope of reaching NASA.
​How We Built It:
Without funds for expensive servers or paid data, we turned our poverty into innovation. Using free-tier cloud platforms, open-source tools, and public demo APIs, we engineered a lightweight, fast web application from scratch—proving that zero budget cannot stop a determined mind.
​What Our App Does:
NASA-Learn-Web is an all-in-one gateway to astronomy and science. Users can explore planets, distant stars, and breathtaking nebulae, watch live HD video streams directly from the International Space Station (ISS), and track real-time space telemetry.
​This project is our heart on a screen—built to inspire every underprivileged kid who dares to look at the night sky and dream of NASA.
details:
​Our Story & Dream:

We are young dreamers from Sri Lanka with one ultimate goal: to one day walk the halls of NASA and serve humanity through space exploration. Growing up without wealth or high-end resources, many told us that space science was out of our reach. We refused to accept that. Competing in the NASA International Space Apps Challenge is our chance to prove that raw talent, relentless curiosity, and a burning passion for the cosmos are stronger than money. Every line of code in this project carries our sweat, late nights, and unbreakable hope of reaching NASA.

​How We Built It:

Without funds for expensive servers or paid data, we turned our limitations into innovation. Using free-tier cloud platforms, open-source tools, and public demo APIs, we engineered a lightweight, fast web application from scratch—proving that zero budget cannot stop a determined mind.

​What Our App Does:

NASA-Learn-Web is an all-in-one digital gateway to science and astronomy, designed to make the cosmos accessible to everyone:

  • ​Deep Space Exploration: Users can explore detailed data on planets, stars, galaxies, and majestic nebulae, turning complex astronomy into interactive learning.
  • ​Live ISS Video Streams: Experience real-time HD video feeds directly from the International Space Station (ISS), looking down at Earth just like an astronaut.
  • ​Real-Time Data: Powered by live API integrations, it continuously fetches up-to-date space telemetry and discoveries.

​This project is our heart on a screen—built to inspire every underprivileged kid who dares to look at the night sky and dream of NASA.
